definition: to gain points in a game
description: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

de.answer: Er schießt im Park ein Tor.
de.question: Was macht der Junge?

es.answer: Está marcando un gol en el parque.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el niño?

fr.answer: Il marque un but dans le parc.
